hero.title: Every journey, handled with comfort, discretion and precision from the very first mile.
hero.subtitle:
Carefully selected drivers. Premium electric vehicles.
A solid, reliable standard for those who do not improvise their mobility in Mexico City.
hero.note: Service requests are subject to operational review and manual confirmation.

local.title: Mexico City, mobility at a higher standard.
local.body: Clean routes, controlled timing and a consistent experience. Designed for work, travel and special occasions.

standard.title: A standard designed for silence.
standard.subtitle:
High-end electric mobility.
Space. Calm. Stability.
standard.origin: Pixkuy takes its name from Totonac, one of Mexico’s indigenous languages. It means “roadrunner”. A way of naming what is essential: the detail that sustains. That same logic defines the standard through which we understand mobility.

services.title: Not every need is the same.

airport.title: Airport and hotel
airport.text: Planned transfers for arrivals and departures with a clear and carefully handled experience.

tours.title: Private tours and visits
tours.text: Private journeys to emblematic places and tailored plans with a dedicated chauffeur.

hourly.title: By the hour or by the day
hourly.text: A flexible service for schedules, meetings and journeys with multiple stops.

events.title: Events and special occasions
events.text: When the transfer accompanies an important occasion and needs to match the moment.

direct.title: Direct transfers
direct.text: A clear journey between two points with the same door-to-door service standard.

services.bridge: Pixkuy is built for those who value planning, discretion and a stable service standard.

intro.title: The Pixkuy experience is also defined by the vehicle.
intro.subtitle: Not every journey requires the same space, nor does every car offer the same experience.

zeekr.title: Zeekr 001
zeekr.subtitle: Executive electric sedan
zeekr.desc: Silence, stability and comfort for longer journeys.
zeekr.note: Designed for transfers where the journey itself is part of the agenda.

m9.title: BYD M9
m9.subtitle: Executive electric van
m9.desc: Real space for people, luggage and working on the move.
m9.note: Built for trips involving guests or multiple operational needs.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.body1: This website is for informational purposes only and allows service requests subject to operational review and manual confirmation.
notice.body2: The information presented may change without prior notice depending on operational availability.
notice.contactBody: Please use this website’s form to get in touch.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body1: Data provided through the form is used solely to manage your transfer request and the communications necessary to handle it.
privacy.body2: We do not share data with third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy.purposeBody: To manage transfer or reservation requests, respond to related inquiries, and coordinate the communications necessary to provide the service.
privacy.legalBasisBody: The consent given by the data subject when submitting the form.
privacy.retentionBody: Data will be retained for as long as necessary to manage the request and the related communications, unless a different legal obligation applies.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, rectification or deletion in accordance with applicable regulations, using this website’s form.
privacy.securityBody: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are applied to protect data against unauthorized access.

cookies.title: Cookies policy
cookies.body1: This website does not use cookies for advertising or tracking purposes.
cookies.body2: If cookies are introduced in the future, you will be properly informed and consent will be requested when applicable.
cookies.body3: Language preferences may be stored locally in the browser to improve the browsing experience.
